description: Defines the 'Role' entity class for user administration, including properties such as name, description, permissions, and methods for updating and permission checks within the Fineract project.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Entity representing user roles with associated permissions, supporting CRUD operations, permission checks, and state toggling (enabled/disabled).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Role instance from a JSON command containing role details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates role properties based on a JSON command and returns the changes made.

methods.name: updatePermission
methods.description: Adds or removes a permission from the role based on the provided boolean flag.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission to the role's permission set.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from the role's permission set.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of permissions associated with the role.

methods.name: hasPermissionTo
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specific permission by code.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the role to its data transfer object representation.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the role is disabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the role is enabled.
